objects.name: Detection technique coverage: github-enterprise-pause-audit-log-event-stream
objects.description: The following analytic detects when a user pauses audit log event streaming in GitHub Enterprise. The detection monitors GitHub Enterprise audit logs for configuration changes that temporarily suspend the audit log streaming functionality, which is used to send audit events to security monitoring platforms.
